Agency.description: Government department, municipality, authority, public corporation, or other public-sector sponsor.

Vendor.description: Contractor, subcontractor, service provider, logistics provider, infrastructure firm, or recurring award recipient.
relationships: links to Finding through concentration or risk factor

Contract.description: Procurement award, grant, payment, invoice, amendment, or emergency allocation.

Site.description: Geocoded location, parcel, facility, infrastructure asset, municipality feature, or sensitive location.

Event.description: Time-bound observation: contract action, imagery change, flight record, outage, report, permit, or field note.

Source.description: Original record, dataset, imagery product, report, witness record, or secondary item used as evidence.

Anomaly.description: Pattern deviation requiring investigation; never an extraordinary conclusion by itself.

Finding.description: Traceable analytical output with evidence, confidence, contradictions, and missing data.

Investigation.description: Persistent analytical workspace with active vector, lead queue, findings, and status.
